notablePrerequisites:
Vrondiss is indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Vrondiss.
description:
Deal damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss triggers, creating a 5/4 Dragon Spirit creature token.
When the Dragon Spirit enters, Clash of Realities triggers, dealing 3 damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss and the Dragon Spirit trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Spirit trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the Vrondiss trigger, creating a 5/4 Dragon Spirit creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
